items.title: Integrated framework for landscape connectivity in agricultural systems
items.one_liner: An integrated multi-scale framework for economically feasible landscape connectivity in working agriculture has been published.
items.why: Directly supports spatial modeling and landscape configuration methods for peri-urban agriculture and habitat quality.
items.action: Read the Nature article to evaluate its multi-scale landscape connectivity methodology.

items.title: Korea to Target Green Gaps With 3-30-300 Urban Forest Rule
items.one_liner: Korea aims to address urban green gaps by implementing the 3-30-300 urban forest rule.
items.why: Informs urban forestry metrics, green-blue infrastructure planning, and access to urban nature relevant to the student's work.
items.action: Examine how the 3-30-300 rule is operationalized for urban cooling and equity.

items.title: Baghdad's Green Spaces Shrink as Construction Threatens Old Trees
items.one_liner: Construction pressures in Baghdad are causing green spaces to shrink and threatening old trees.
items.why: Provides a Global South case study on land-cover change and the loss of urban ecosystem services like cooling.
items.action: Review drivers of urban tree loss to compare with development pressures in Kabul.

items.title: Bangladesh urges grant-based climate finance at COP31
items.one_liner: Bangladesh called for grant-based climate finance and faster fund access at COP31 negotiations.
items.why: Reflects Global South perspectives on securing international climate and adaptation funds for vulnerable cities.
items.action: Monitor COP31 policy discussions regarding funding mechanisms for urban resilience.

items.title: Bengaluru Eco-Parks Plan: Can Green Cover Recover?
items.one_liner: Bengaluru is implementing an eco-parks plan to try and recover lost urban green cover.
items.why: Offers insight into metropolitan environmental planning, habitat quality, and green-blue infrastructure in the Global South.
items.action: Study the proposed planning instruments used in Bengaluru's eco-parks framework.

items.title: Judge strikes down New York’s Climate Change Superfund Act
items.one_liner: A judge has struck down New York’s Climate Change Superfund Act.
items.why: Highlights judicial challenges in enforcing climate adaptation and environmental funding regulations.
items.action: Read the court ruling to understand legal boundaries for climate funding mechanisms.

items.title: Safer homes, stronger cities report by UNDP
items.one_liner: The United Nations Development Programme released a report focusing on safer homes and stronger cities.
items.why: Addresses urban vulnerability, informal settlements, and resilience planning in developing contexts.
items.action: Review the UNDP report for frameworks on building urban resilience in fragile settings.

items.title: Assessing barriers to ecosystem-based adaptation on tropical islands
items.one_liner: Research evaluates the barriers to ecosystem-based adaptation using a case study application on tropical islands.
items.why: Informs the study of ecosystem service supply, institutional governance, and adaptation barriers.
items.action: Examine the identified barriers to ecosystem-based adaptation for comparative insights.
